hold_reason: Refund mismatch: the batch requested refunds for orders 281 (8009), 283 (16221), and 285 (5341), but only 281 and 285 were applied. The refunds table and Alpha's applied report both show only 281 and 285, so order 283's refund of 16221 is missing. Paying net balances now would overpay the customer on order 283. Please have W2/Alpha confirm whether the 283 refund should be applied before any payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: Before recording any payout, I need to compare the refunds table against what Alpha reported. I'll start by listing the refunds.

The refunds table matches what Alpha reported as applied (281 and 285). But the batch also requested a refund for order 283 ($162.21), which was never applied. Paying out now would likely overpay that customer, and payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold for review.
